author: copilot
subject: Implemented structured verification for findings and reports
body: Allowed schema v2 verification metadata on finding and report while keeping it mandatory on verdict and rejecting it on other kinds. The same validation now applies everywhere: unique non-empty methods, non-empty command strings, and at least one command for tests-executed. MCP exchange_post accepts the field. Late non-gating reports preserve a resolved verdict. Generated slugs now prefer the last complete word when truncation would split a word. Documentation records these decisions.
